Messages.Author: Michal Kranc
Messages.Body:
Deck : Giovanni / Nosf. / Nosf. Antitr.

What keeps it together ( the combos ) :

Minion tap + Golconda + Posession : Mtap a vampire for it's full cap (
now it's free ) , Golconda it ( now u gain pool = to it's capacity ) , Posess
it ( now it comes right back to play ) . Spice the combo with Soul Gem of
Ethrius for the maximum efect .

Ambrousius the Ferryman + Tablot's Chainsaw : Give the chainsaw to
Ambrousius and here is what u get >>

1. he does not take damage that is not agrivatted !

2. prevents 1 damage

3. gets optional press

4. can attack any minion as +1 stealth action

5. does 3 damage ( can u say pulled fangs :) )

3 hunting grounds + Blood dolls : self explenatory :)

ho...@intergate.bc.ca (Michal Kranc) writes:
> Ambrousius the Ferryman + Tablot's Chainsaw : Give the chainsaw to
>Ambrousius and here is what u get >>

Be careful with this trick - I've had my Talbot-wielding Ferryman stolen
before I could use him for even one combat. I spent a total of six pool
only to see the Ferryman serving my Prey (and later, my Predator).

He makes a popular target.
